# 7451 - Dual 2-wide 2-input AND-OR-INVERT gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7451.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7451.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 2 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 3 | 2B | input |  |  |
| 4 | 2C | input |  |  |
| 5 | 2D | input |  |  |
| 6 | 2Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | 1Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 1C | input |  |  |
| 10 | 1D | input |  |  |
| 11 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 12 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 13 | 1B | input |  |  |
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 1Y = NOT ((1A AND 1B) OR (1C AND 1D)) | Gate 1: 1Y is low when 1A and 1B are both high, or 1C and 1D are both high. |
| 6 | 2Y = NOT ((2A AND 2B) OR (2C AND 2D)) | Gate 2: 2Y is low when 2A and 2B are both high, or 2C and 2D are both high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 13 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Notes

Same pinout as the 7450 without the expander: pins 11 and 12 are marked 'make no external connection' on page 5-16. Positive logic Y = NOT(AB + CD). Switching table on page 6-31 ('51): tPLH 13 typ / 22 max ns, tPHL 8 typ / 15 max ns; IOH -400 uA and IOL 16 mA (74 family) on page 6-30. No minimum delays given; the path-delay function uses 0 ns.
